description: Owner decisions D1 / D4 and context-eval fixes P7 / P10 (2026-10-26) gold CANDIDATES for nl-select.v69. The owner approved all 20 as-is on 2026-10-26 (ADR-0120 D12 batch). They are NOT yet in nl-intent.v1.json: that file is also the ADR-0121 Q11 one-step planner gold (every case, by id) and the ADR-0123 gold the selector-RAG pool is linted and embedding-audited against, so moving them needs the owner's decision on those two gates (DECISIONS, 2026-10-26). Until then eval:nl and read-regression score them only through this file's tests. Same schema as nl-intent.v1.json; `prior.turns` (chat turns since the listing) and `prior.earlier` (the latest selection of each other source) are rendered exactly as the runtime renders them; `openQuestion` (the help-scope question shown) and `expectAnswer` (the option a worded reply means; absent = not an answer) score D4. Phrasings are new: none copies a context-eval scenario turn or a prompt example.
